name: find-a-friend
description: Atalhos para rodar o backend e o frontend localmente.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate
scripts.dev: npm run db:up && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: cd backend && npx prisma db seed
